Description: Cloud Library: DynamoDB, Cognito, private S3/CloudFront, Lambda HTTP API, Bedrock, reminders and audio.

Properties.FunctionCode: function handler(event) { var request = event.request; if (!request.uri.startsWith("/api/") && !request.uri.split("/").pop().includes(".")) request.uri = "/index.html"; return request; }
